verdict.line: You lose if you flail Facebreaker with no minions flanking her and eat a full trade while her W (Defiant Dance) is up; you win if you tank her pokes for Grit and dump W (Haymaker) the moment her W or Q (Bladesurge) go on cooldown.

brief.thesis: Sett's E (Facebreaker) only stuns when Irelia is sandwiched between bodies on opposite sides — against a lone champion that means using the minion wave, not just walking up. Because Irelia's W (Defiant Dance) cuts incoming physical damage only while she's charging it, and her Q (Bladesurge) is her only reset/escape, this lane is decided by tracking those two cooldowns and punishing the gaps, which lines up with Sett's measured 55.7% win rate and solo-kill edge over 646 games.

theirWindow.what: She takes reduced physical damage while charging it and can burst you or trade back safely, and if she has a Bladesurge reset off a marked target or minion she can disengage clean. Don't stand and swing through this — poke with autos or wait it out.

yourWindow.when: Her W and Q are both down
yourWindow.what: With W (20/18/16/14/12s) and Q (10/9/8/7/6s) both on cooldown she has no damage reduction and no gap-closer or escape. Walk your minion wave to flank her, land Facebreaker for the stun, and dump Haymaker's stored Grit — this is your kill window, not a poke window.

start.why: The 57% win rate pick over 721 games — the extra sustain matters because your whole trade pattern is tanking her pokes to fill Grit, not avoiding them.

boots.why: 54.2% win rate and 77.7% pick rate; flat physical damage reduction directly undercuts her stacking Ionian Fervor autos.

core.why: The slow-on-hit active lets you stick to her after a Facebreaker stun instead of watching her Bladesurge away.
Max health feeds a bigger Grit pool for Haymaker's true-damage dump and stacks with Pit Grit's missing-health regen.
The low-health shield keeps you alive through her burst window and pairs with Pit Grit for extended brawls.

fights are going long and you need Facebreaker and Haymaker back up faster to keep the stun-lock uptime
she goes tanky late and you need percent-health damage and a slow to stop her from disengaging

runes.keystoneWhy: The 66.3% win rate page — sustained fighting stacks Conqueror into healing, which rewards exactly the tank-and-punish trade pattern this matchup calls for.

summoners.why: 92.5% pick rate at 55.2% win rate. Ignite cuts through the self-heal off her Bladesurge and converts your solo-kill advantage into an actual kill instead of a reset.

playing.title: Only stun with minions flanking
playing.detail: Facebreaker needs enemies on opposite sides of you to stun; against a solo Irelia that means walking the wave so she's caught between a minion and you. If she's alone on your side, E only slows — don't waste it expecting a stun.

playing.title: Tank pokes, then dump Haymaker
playing.detail: Pit Grit converts damage you take into stored Grit for W. Let her Bladesurge or auto hit you, then cash out the shield and true-damage punch rather than trying to dodge everything.

playing.title: Track her W cooldown all lane
playing.detail: Defiant Dance (20/18/16/14/12s) is her only damage-reduction tool. Commit hard trades only when it's down; back off or poke when it's up.

playing.title: Save all-ins for her Q down
playing.detail: Bladesurge is her escape and reset. If it's been used and hasn't refreshed off a mark or kill, she has no gap-closer out — this is when Facebreaker into full combo is safest.

playing.title: Ult off a landed stun
playing.detail: The Show Stopper (120/100/80s at ranks 1-3) guarantees a kill once she's stunned or slowed and can't Bladesurge away. Look for it right after a clean Facebreaker hit, level 6 onward.

playing.title: Watch Ionian Fervor stacks
playing.detail: Her passive gives stacking attack speed on spell hits, with bonus on-hit damage at max stacks. If she's fully stacked, don't extend an auto-trade without Grit already banked for a shield.

playing.title: Itemize to her build
playing.detail: If she rushes armor, pick up Black Cleaver for the shred; if she goes tanky and mobile, Blade of The Ruined King's slow keeps her from just Bladesurging out of your combos.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and every win rate cited here are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (32,190 Sett top games overall, 646 vs Irelia). The mechanical reasoning — why to hold E for a flank, when to dump Grit, which cooldown to track — is my own read of the ability kits, not a stat.
